reservoir. The reservoir will have a gas inlet and outlet and a water inlet and 
overflow. The level regulator controls the volume of hydrogen production by 
adjusting the electric current of the rectifier. A four-stage compressor cooled 
by air to 20 MPa outlet pressure presses the hydrogen from the reservoir. Into 
the suction part of the compressor, a filter for trapping eventual traces of KOH 
is inserted. The filter body is of carbon steel, the candle filter of 
polypropylene. The filling station will be at the same time for filling four 
high-pressure steel bottles with hydrogen to 20 MPa final pressures

of several detectors in the machince. The design is such that the contacts are
opened and closed in proper sequence when transferring from one detector to
another. Another position connects to the calibrated test resistor to check the
temperature meter at the 70-degree point. The construction of RTD'S is shown in
